observations: Photo 0: A large rectangular solar panel with a grid of dark photovoltaic cells in a white frame; glare/bright reflection across the surface.
Photo 1: Another view of the same solar panel; the cells and frame are visible; still no clear wattage/label visible.

Photo 3: Back/underside view again; connectors/cables visible; a small central marking is present but not readable.

claims.claim: Thank you for contacting Network Solar venture Please let us know how we can help you. We deal...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; no specific product specs (wattage, brand, condition) provided in the message.

risks.risk: Wattage/size rating is not readable from the photos, so the price could be for a lower or higher capacity panel.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker (brand + model + rated power in Wp) on the frame/back.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic mid-range used solar PV module with unknown wattage (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Condition/defects (cracks, delamination, hot spots) are not verifiable; glare hides surface details.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the cell surface (no glare) plus a photo of the frame corners and any junction box area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used and potentially not fully reliable (worst-case for performance).

risks.risk: Electrical condition (whether it produces rated output) is unknown.
risks.proof: A working test: IV curve or at least an output reading under sunlight with a multimeter/solar tester, showing voltage/current.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/assumed not meeting rated output.

risks.risk: Compatibility details are unknown (connector type, cable length, junction box condition).
risks.proof: Close-up of the junction box and connector type (e.g., MC4) and a photo showing cable length from panel to end.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring possible adapter/cable replacement.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the panel rating label/sticker showing brand, model, and rated power (Wp).
Close-up photos of the junction box and connector type (and cable length).
A performance test photo/video (IV curve or measured voltage/current under sun).
Clear photos of the cell surface and frame corners without glare.
response.reason: The photos show a solar PV panel, but the key pricing driver (rated wattage/brand/model) and condition/performance proof are not readable or verifiable from the images provided.
